items.context: Dating and social startup; sole engineer across the Flutter app, NestJS backend, and Docker deployment, maintaining two product lines (Sugarbee and Bound)
jobDesc: Delivered four paid subscription AI features on the Anthropic API: match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, bio generation.
Built multi-tier degradation and calibrated timeouts so service stays up when the model fails.
Built a Python RAG support agent that escalates to a human when confidence is low.
Ran the backend on AWS Lambda, with long-running work handled asynchronously through SQS.
Traced connection build-up caused by frozen Lambda containers, cutting peak connections by 24%.
Rewrote queries with virtual generated columns and composite indexes: 5s → milliseconds, APIs averaging 180ms.
Reworked resource architecture and caching: cloud spend −60%, first paint 10s → 1.4s.
Took over subscription billing with auto-renewal and failed-payment retries; monthly revenue NT$210K → NT$380K.

items.context: Game and live-streaming platform; joined in 2020 as a backend engineer, promoted in late 2022 to lead the team
jobDesc: Led an 11-person cross-functional engineering team across delivery, stability, and quality.
Owned 12 game and platform products from system design and development through launch.
Designed the microservice architecture carrying peak-hour traffic of a thousand bets and orders per second.
Used Kafka, Redis, and Bull Queue for cross-service event streams, caching, and async settlement.
Standardized and documented monitoring and troubleshooting, cutting problem isolation time by 50%.
Established a release checklist and release process, reducing release defects by 70%.
Drove design review and code review as the shared development standard across product lines.

items.context: Same company, pre-promotion role; backend development and system analysis on a game and lottery platform
jobDesc: Developed and operated game, lottery, fair-random-number, crawler data, and admin systems.
Lead backend on the blockchain fair-random-number platform, writing EOS smart contracts for on-chain proof.
Refactored an unmaintained legacy system into layered modules so new game types extend directly.
Located bottlenecks from slow-query logs, adding indexes and rewriting queries to remove settlement timeouts.
Provided API and key technical documentation to improve cross-team collaboration.

items.context: Software consultancy; delivered 7 client engagements spanning requirements analysis through production operations
jobDesc: Delivered lending, video streaming, equipment repair, and e-commerce systems from zero to one.
Handled transcoding asynchronously with AWS Lambda + FFmpeg and introduced automated deployment.
Split frontend/backend responsibilities and redesigned APIs to cut module coupling.
Established unit and functional testing to cover regression after changes.
Selected stacks by the client's existing environment: C#, Node.js, React, Salesforce.
